digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` must be treated as neutral—contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations—rather than as undeclared and forcing whole-HEAD invalidation

Container scope inheritance must implement exact precedence: own/cited/inherited paths → `paths`; else explicit parent `none` → `none`; else all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent → `none`; else `unscoped`, with parent `paths` never promoted to `none`

The child-impact computation must return both declared paths and an all-none flag so that dependency hashing, container classification, and P9 assessment all consume the same tri-state rule without poisoning from undeclared children when siblings are truthfully `none`

Cheap resign in `resign.py` must reconstruct and sign the same child-derived scope from the immutable relation snapshot without network reads, refusing structurally on inconsistency rather than falling back to broader or narrower scope

P9 must pass leaves and containers declared `none` or with all live children authenticated; it must name only live undeclared children as poisoners and offer both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies
